tasks.title: Map current lifecycle, resolver and source consumers
tasks.goal: Create an exact factual starting map for the known behavior/authority gaps before architectural changes.
steps: Read the named call chains and map public entry→consumer→state/effect boundary for lifecycle, feature solve and classified source handling.
Record verified behavior versus target requirement for create-before-verify, solver routes/Fresh, unsafe lookup and foreign-content suffix inference.
Identify exact functions/carriers and bounded fixture recipes for downstream atoms; do not label an unexecuted exploit or imagined test as verified.
positive_cases: Each finding cites a real call path and owning source contract.
Multiple resolver routes and pre-handler verify gates are represented separately.
negative_cases: A field/helper/edge count cannot be accepted as whole-feature proof.
Unverified runtime behavior remains labeled unverified rather than assumed.
acceptance: The map distinguishes source facts, inference, owner rule and required runtime evidence.
No product code, generated lane or user state changed.
tasks.safe_stop: Read-only consumer map is complete and can feed M-16-A without waiting for M-13-B.
tasks.commit_subject: docs(campaign): record exact current consumer and authority seams
notes: This is a factual census leaf, not a new acceptance verdict. Positive/negative cases describe the evidence classification to check; no product tests are claimed.

tasks.title: Census active owned versions and data boundaries
tasks.goal: Identify exactly which active own manifests/policies may change while excluding foreign/history/generated data.
steps: Use the actual workspace members and root package declarations to enumerate active owned package/product manifests; bind additional exact manifest paths before reading them.
Classify each current version/constraint/document mention as active own, upstream/third-party, frozen historical capture, fixture or machine epoch; record current 1.0.0 state.
Build a closed proposed edit list for M-13-D and a root/data/source authority table; preserve unknown ownership as a binding question rather than blanket replacement.
positive_cases: Every active owned item in the resolved census has current version and owner evidence.
Machine format epochs and upstream pins remain separate from product version.
negative_cases: Historical receipts/fixtures/dependency versions cannot enter the own-version edit list.
Unbound additional package roots cannot be silently claimed complete.
acceptance: Census includes an explicit denominator and exact per-file proposed perimeter.
Any extra manifest binding needed for exhaustive coverage is named for the root.
tasks.safe_stop: Accepted exact manifest census is ready; no version changed.
tasks.commit_subject: docs(campaign): census active ownership versions and source boundaries
notes: Only baseline-listed root/Redbook manifests and Cargo member declarations are currently bound. Root must add exact discovered owned-manifest read paths before claiming a complete active-package census; this is file binding, not reopening D-019.
